_comment: Rules of skill identify-comparable-transactions. A rule computes only if its status is VERIFIED-REOPENED or ENGINEERING RULE; a [CHECK] rule is disabled and the script prints [CHECK].

rules.reason: the team states the criteria; no default set is shipped
every deal carries a source reference and date so a reader can audit it; nothing from memory

rules.passage: The guideline transactions method is generally the only market approach method that can be applied to intangible assets.

rules.reason: completed deals only can bias a range; the flag is raised when no terminated or withdrawn deal is present
the maximum gaps a deal may carry is the team's input
owner ruling V5: the adopted valuation, the choice of rate and any fairness or solvency view are human only
